messages.author: 29ce8550baceaeb0
messages.subject: Strange error resolved on re-installation
parts:
Hi all, 

Just posting a strange error that I had and resolved (just in case anyone runs into the same error). When compiling a model, I was getting: 

error: no member named 'model' in namespace 'stan'

I spent a good day or so hunting down the problem but couldn't find one. On re-installing rstan from Cran, the compilation worked. 

Jim

messages.subject: Re: Strange error resolved on re-installation

Just posting a strange error that I had and resolved (just in case anyone runs into the same error). When compiling a model, I was getting: 

error: no member named 'model' in namespace 'stan'

I spent a good day or so hunting down the problem but couldn't find one. On re-installing rstan from Cran, the compilation worked.

I have seen error messages like that with older versions of R but they usually go away with some combination of removing all the old rstans, installing the new one, and restarting R.

Ben
